articles.title: SlotDiT: Object-Centric Representations for Diffusion Transformers
articles.summary: Text-conditioned latent diffusion models perform strongly in video generation and are promising backbones for robotic applications. While they have shown success in dynamics modeling and planning, they have not yet been explored for diffusion-based generative modeling. We introduce SlotDiT, a text-guided Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates in a slot-based latent space.
